threats.scenario: An untrusted client attempts to impersonate the UI, worker, or fleet agent.
threats.residualRisk: Misconfigured local development credentials can weaken role boundaries.

threats.scenario: A caller modifies operation payloads, catalog data, or NATS command bodies.
threats.residualRisk: A compromised operator account can still submit authorized destructive changes.

threats.scenario: A sensitive release, vault, drift, or restore action cannot be traced after execution.
threats.residualRisk: Local storage loss can remove evidence unless backed up.

threats.scenario: Secrets leak through logs, events, audit payloads, UI streams, or DLQ records.
threats.residualRisk: New secret field names need continuous review.

threats.scenario: NATS, worker, OPA, Vault, or the API becomes unavailable during an operation.
threats.residualRisk: Single-device edge deployments remain capacity constrained.

threats.scenario: A lower-privileged path triggers privileged operations such as release apply, restore, or secret rotation.
threats.residualRisk: Policy gaps can appear when new operations are added without matching guardrails.
